description: Department of Local Government - North Western Province - Meeting for the Purpose of Electing the Vice Chairman for the Maho Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the schedule for a meeting to elect the Vice Chairman of the Maho Pradeshiya Sabha, which is an electoral process matter under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It falls under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it specifically deals with local government election procedures and scheduling.
